name: alert-dialog
blurb: Modal alert for destructive actions or important confirmations.
description: A compound component wrapping Radix AlertDialog with styled overlay, animations, and footer buttons for confirm/cancel flows.
use_when: Asking for confirmation before destructive actions like delete, logout, or data removal.
avoid_when: For informational messages — use a toast or snackbar instead.
a11y: Radix AlertDialog with focus management, keyboard dismissal (Esc), and semantic title/description.
